findings.evidence: `rg "unweightedAbelJacobiDegreeZeroDivisor" code -n` finds only its definition and its own private/public coercion lemmas at `WeilDivisor.lean:535,541,547`.
findings.fix: Delete it and its simp lemma, or make it private/local if a proof still needs it; consumers should use `weightedAbelJacobiDegreeZeroDivisor (fun _ => 1) rfl` plus the weighted API instead.
findings.issue: `unweightedAbelJacobiDegreeZeroDivisor` remains a public unweighted Abel-Jacobi representative helper even though the PR deletes the unweighted Abel-Jacobi quotient/divisor-class API it supported.

findings.evidence: `rg "degreeZeroSubgroupEquivWeightedDegreeZeroOne" code -n` finds only the exposed definition and its own apply/coe lemmas at `WeilDivisor.lean:554,573,583,589,599`.
findings.fix: Remove this equivalence and its four simp lemmas unless a roadmap-facing consumer requires it; otherwise keep any needed transport private to the weighted implementation.
findings.issue: `degreeZeroSubgroupEquivWeightedDegreeZeroOne` and its simp API are still exposed as a public weight-one transport layer, but after the unweighted quotient equivalences were removed it has no remaining consumers.

summary: The specialized unweighted Abel-Jacobi/Pic0 layer is mostly collapsed, but two leftover public weight-one helper APIs remain with no consumers. These should not stay in the exported surface after the corresponding unweighted quotient layer is removed.
